Write them in a journal. Generally other people can't help with your thoughts and feelings in any conversational way. Hugs are nice when you're feeling down, but "talking about it" usually makes it worse. If you're feeling down, simply write it all out in a journal or piece of paper, keep it or destroy it, and if you need more, get a trusted friend to silently listen and give hugs without speaking. Remember this is about your thoughts and feelings, and not their reaction to them.

Slowly, over time, as you stop receiving negative reactions to your (most likely strong) thoughts and feelings, you'll start to feel better about having them in general, regardless of what they are.

Its tricky to understand, but we have layers of feelings. We have feelings about our feelings. We can take on other people feelings. It can get messy and complicated. Which is why you need the silence to go through your feelings. Talking about them can usually just get you stuck in the feeling.
